new file .changeset/absolutize-real-tags.md
+---
+'@ogygia/federation': patch
+---
+
+A peer's asset refs are pinned to its origin only in the attribute values of real tags: text on a peer page that looks like one (a code sample, a comment, script text) reaches the shell as the peer wrote it.

new file .changeset/head-readers-raw-text.md
+---
+'@ogygia/core': patch
+---
+
+`@ogygia/core`: the server's head checks, link dedupe and runtime placement, and the router's prefetch warm read a page the way the browser does: a tag written inside a comment or inside a script's, title's or textarea's text no longer counts, so the runtime is never moved into a commented-out script or a title, a real stylesheet is never dropped as a copy of a commented one, and text that looks like a region no longer makes the router import a module.

new file .changeset/markup-readers-core.md
+---
+'@ogygia/core': patch
+'ogygia': patch
+---
+
+A hole answer's region URLs, island graph and region CSS are read as a browser reads the tags: a region or sheet inside an HTML comment is left alone, and upper-case tags, single-quoted values and a quoted `>` no longer hide one.

new file .changeset/markup-readers-devtools.md
+---
+'@ogygia/devtools': patch
+---
+
+The profiler's byte breakdown, page seed and standalone export read the page as a browser does: tags inside comments are ignored, and quoted `>`, single quotes and upper-case attributes no longer mislead them.

new file .changeset/markup-readers-federation.md
+---
+'@ogygia/federation': patch
+---
+
+A mounted peer page's head is read as a browser reads it: a title or stylesheet inside a comment is ignored, an unquoted `rel` counts, and a meta whose quoted content holds `>` is carried whole instead of cut.

new file .changeset/markup-readers-postrender.md
+---
+'@ogygia/postrender': patch
+---
+
+Stitching finds stitch holes as a browser reads the page: a hole inside a comment, or a region whose class merely says "stitch", is no longer stitched, and an upper-case or single-quoted `stitch` attribute is.

new file .changeset/markup-readers-router.md
+---
+'@ogygia/router': patch
+---
+
+A streamed page whose head closes as `</head >` (space or newline before `>`) gets its late boot, and a comment naming `</head>` before the page no longer takes it.

new file .changeset/queue-clock-mono.md
+---
+'@ogygia/machine': patch
+---
+
+`@ogygia/machine`: `queue()` with no `now` reads its deadlines on `clock.mono()`, like every other primitive, so a run that drives the clock drives the queue too.

+/**
+ * THE PAGE MARKUP'S VOCABULARY (#479). Server HTML and the runtime meet through `data-og*` /
+ * `data-ogygia-*` attributes: the server writes them, and the runtime, the router, federation,
